facts.text: Guided by the Jesuit educational tradition since 1851, Saint Joseph's University features a 125-acre Hawk Hill campus and a 24-acre University City campus in Philadelphia.

sources.title: About | We Are Hawks | Saint Joseph's University
sources.quote: Guided by the Jesuit educational tradition since 1851, Saint Joseph's has shaped passionate people with curious minds and real-world skills

sources.title: About | We Are Hawks | Saint Joseph's University
sources.quote: Our 125-acre Hawk Hill and 24-acre University City campuses offer students the best of both worlds: a historic Main Line suburb and a vibrant Philadelphia neighborhood
